## anu-p07 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Of things no arising; naturally they shine by your contemplation, even the non-true partaking of truth for a moment. This universe-glory is will-born from you, birth from elsewhere denied; hence you shine in worlds — one, yet many-selfed.

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) — The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of recognition (pratyabhijñā); the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at one, yet many-selfed. The rasa is the tranquility of non-dual self-manifestation — the Absolute shining in worlds without being divided.*
